sites.name: Dan River Community Health, Main Street
Dan River Community Health, South Boston

resources.name: Southside Area Agency on Aging — Alzheimer's respite program
resources.summary: Up to 10 hours a week of in-home respite for caregivers of people with dementia; sliding scale, waitlist varies by county.

resources.name: Halifax Senior Services respite vouchers
resources.summary: Quarterly respite vouchers redeemable with approved in-home aides.

resources.name: Dan River Adult Day Center
resources.summary: Weekday adult day program with memory-care track; transport within 15 miles of Danville.

resources.name: South Boston Adult Day Health
resources.summary: Adult day health with nursing on site, Monday to Friday.

resources.name: Pittsylvania Rides (demand-response transit)
resources.summary: Door-to-door rides for medical appointments; book 48 hours ahead.

resources.name: Halifax County Medical Transport
resources.summary: Medicaid non-emergency medical transportation broker and volunteer drivers.

resources.name: Henry–Martinsville Ride Connect
resources.summary: Volunteer driver program for older adults; medical appointments prioritized.

resources.name: Meals on Wheels of Southside Virginia
resources.summary: Weekday home-delivered meals; dementia-friendly check-in at the door.

resources.name: Memory Café at Danville Public Library
resources.summary: Second Tuesday monthly; a social hour for people living with dementia and their care partners.

resources.name: Caregiver Circle — Chatham
resources.summary: Peer support group for family caregivers, evenings, with respite care on site.

resources.name: Halifax Caregiver Support Group
resources.summary: Monthly support group facilitated by a licensed counselor.

resources.name: Southside Legal Aid — advance directives clinic
resources.summary: Free help with powers of attorney, advance medical directives and Medicaid long-term-care applications.

resources.name: Piedmont Home Care Partners
resources.summary: Licensed personal-care aides; Medicaid waiver and private pay.

resources.name: Dan River Behavioral Health — caregiver counseling
resources.summary: Short-term counseling for caregivers; telehealth available.

resources.name: Mecklenburg Senior Center adult day
resources.summary: Adult day program three days a week in Boydton.

resources.name: Lake Country Rides
resources.summary: Scheduled medical transport across Mecklenburg County.
